parsed.summary: Substantively honest, well-bounded implementation: the local_rehearsal ceiling is enforced in code (TransportAck has no promotion surface, CompletedHop/CycleProof have real verification, witnesses are reverified on read including verifier fingerprint), composition uses the canonical manifest/A2A server/runtime DB/CatalyticGraph rather than a rival store, and negative tests cover nonterminal tasks, ACK non-promotion, and artifact tampering. However, two truthfulness gaps prevent merge-as-stated: (1) the 'every active project is bound' invariant exists only as a pytest assertion, not in validate_portfolio, so the API/dashboard contract_valid can stay green while the metabolism silently unbinds a newly activated track, and _active_track_ids ignores status while the test filters status=='ACTIVE' (inconsistent definitions); (2) the dashboard TS contract drops the server-computed topology object entirely, so server-side validation_errors are never rendered and the UI's green states are derived only from client-side ring math. dharma_swarm/autocatalytic_portfolio.validate_portfolio: enforces schema_version, claim_ceiling, ordinal sequence, ids-unique, next_node ring, output_signal -> next input_signal continuity, project_bindings subset of ACTIVE_TRACK.yaml, proof_refs and node doc files exist on disk, ring edges cover all 10 pairs, CatalyticGraph.detect_autocatalytic_sets() must yield exactly one set equal to all ten ids.

promote_completed_hop: requires A2ATaskStatus.COMPLETED, exactly one typed DATA artifact, valid JSON object, _verify_artifact_hash, every expected identity field, contiguous causation, contiguous visited_nodes — nonterminal, missing artifact, and tampered artifact are all rejected.

build_cycle_proof: requires exactly 10 hops, declared node order, all hops terminal and turn-correct, predecessor_hash chain continuous, signal ring closes (last output == first input) — gaps, duplicates, and broken rings are rejected.

verify_cycle_witness: re-derives verifier_sha256 from the running file and portfolio_sha256 from the loaded manifest, rejects on fingerprint mismatch, recomputes every artifact_hash and completion_hash, requires external_effects_proven == False, requires claim_ceiling == local_rehearsal.

TransportAck is a frozen dataclass with no to_completed_hop method and no artifact field; promote_completed_hop's signature accepts an A2ATask, not a TransportAck — the type system blocks the forbidden promotion.

run_local_cycle: registers 10 AgentCards via CardRegistry, dispatches 20 tasks (2 turns × 10 hops) through A2AServer, writes 1 autocatalytic_cycle_proof receipt and 20 a2a_task receipts to the canonical runtime DB via RuntimeStateStore.record_runtime_receipt_sync, persists the witness atomically, and self-verifies before returning.
